content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They host your product, process payments, and handle delivery—until they don’t. When Stripe or PayPal blocks your country, these platforms fail. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, flips this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), the backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), the order storage (Supabase), and the file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. This stack is deployed to your accounts, not COREMERCH’s. You control everything. No platform can shut you down. No country restrictions apply. The tradeoff? You need to deploy it. But once live, it’s yours—permanently.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, regulatory hurdles, or currency instability. This isn’t a technical issue—it’s a business decision. When they pull out, your revenue stops. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by operating at the base layer. Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments don’t care about your country’s politics. They provide tools, not judgments. The Edge Commerce Stack leverages these tools to create a system that works anywhere. It’s not a workaround for restricted platforms—it’s a replacement. You’re not begging for access; you’re building your own. This is the difference between renting a platform and owning your infrastructure. One leaves you vulnerable; the other makes you invulnerable.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus monthly fees for “premium” features. When they block your country, these fees become irrelevant. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5%—no monthly fees, no hidden costs. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes, and the webhook triggers instant product delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost? $197 for the Edge Commerce Stack, deployed in 48 hours. After that, you pay nothing. No subscriptions. No revenue share. Compare this to platforms that take a cut of every sale and can shut you down at any time. Sovereign infrastructure is more expensive upfront but cheaper long-term—and it’s yours forever.
Sovereign infrastructure is ownership, not rental.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Gumroad, your store, customer data, and product files live on their servers. They control access. If they shut down or block your country, you lose everything. Sovereign infrastructure puts you in control. Your store is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Orders are stored in Supabase. Files are delivered via Cloudflare R2. Payments are verified automatically via NOWPayments. The entire system is automated and runs without you. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access. You own the code, the data, and the process. This isn’t just ownership—it’s sovereignty. Your business operates on infrastructure you control, not platforms that can exclude you. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for maintenance. But the reward? No one can take it from you.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and need to sell ebooks today, conventional platforms are not an option. They’re blocked. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy payments are temporary and risky. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators in your situation. It’s not a hack—it’s a system. If you’re willing to deploy it once, you’ll own a store that works anywhere, accepts any cryptocurrency, and delivers products automatically. If you’re still relying on platforms that exclude your country, you’re choosing vulnerability. Sovereign infrastructure is the opposite. It’s built for creators who want control, not permission. Choose architecture, not workarounds.

Unlike Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, which exclude countries based on geopolitical decisions, sovereign stacks like the Edge Commerce Stack operate on tools that don’t discriminate by location. The upfront cost is higher, but the long-term savings and ownership make it the only permanent solution for creators in restricted regions.
